getEntriesForPolicy(bytes32).details: Returns indices into the main log — call getEntry for each one.

getRecentEntries(uint256).details: Useful for the demo — shows the last few actions at a glance.

setWriter(address).details: Called once after SentinelGate is deployed. After this call      the writer is permanently locked. There is no override.

verifyChain(uint256).details: Recomputes every hash from startIndex to the current tip and      checks each one matches what was stored at write time.      Returns true only if every link in the chain is unbroken.      This is the tamper-detection function. If anyone has managed to      alter any entry in storage, this function will return false.

params.startIndex: Where to begin verification (0 = from the beginning)

returns.brokenAt: The index where the first break was found (if any)
returns.intact: Whether the chain is unbroken from startIndex to tip

writeEntry(bytes32,address,uint8,uint256.details: Only SentinelGate may call this. Every field is recorded as-is      with no transformation. The cryptographic chain is maintained      automatically — the caller does not need to manage it.

params.policyId: The active policy at time of action.
params.reason: Why this happened — required for blocked entries.
params.riskScore: The RiskGuardian score at this moment.

getEntriesForAgent(address).notice: Fetch all entry indices recorded against a specific agent.

getEntriesForPolicy(bytes32).notice: Fetch all entry indices recorded against a specific policy.

getEntry(uint256).notice: Fetch a single entry by its position in the log.

getRecentEntries(uint256).notice: Get the most recent N entries across the entire log.

setWriter(address).notice: Authorise the SentinelGate contract as the sole writer.

verifyChain(uint256).notice: Verify that the chain is intact from a given starting entry.

writeEntry(bytes32,address,uint8,uint256.notice: Write a new entry to the log.
